title: Joseph Ducreux's self portraits
content: Joseph Ducreux(1735 –1802) was a French painter best known for his unusual self-portraits.He was interested in the study ofphysiognomy,and wanted to explore expressions that went  beyond the standard ones used in portraiture.Some also involve gestures, such as Le Discret (ca. 1790), which shows himself asking for silence.He studied withMaurice Quentin de La Tour, who was known for his expressive pastel portraits. When Ducreux focused more on oil, his technique was influenced byJean-Baptiste Greuze.Portrait de l'artiste sous les traits d'un moqueur, 1793(Portrait of the Artist in the Guise of Mocking)When the French Revolution broke out, circumstances were more dangerous for Ducreux. He drew the last portrait of Louis XVI before the king's execution. Ducreux was forced to travel to London.His self portrait with the mocking expression has inspired a huge number of memes.We're not used to seeing old paintings or photos of people with facial expressions.
